chapters.title: Welcome to NIPSA UNILESA
paragraphs: Welcome to the NIPSA UNILESA website, the public home of the University of Ilesa Pharmacology student chapter.
Use Menu to find a section, or choose Student Portal for academic support. About NIPSA explains the chapter's purpose.

chapters.title: Academic Resources
paragraphs: Open Resources for the public study guides and departmental materials already available.
The eleven-page Orientation Checklist helps new students prepare. Choose Open to view the PDF in another tab, or Download to save a copy.
The Study Skills Guide is a separate document. Check a resource's title and file format before opening it.
The Resource Drive is an external collection. Use the published links for access; availability may change.

chapters.title: Student Portal and study tools
paragraphs: The Student Portal brings together public academic support and links. Pharmaideia is introduced as an upcoming separate application; registration is not open.
Open Study Tools for GPA estimates, a weekly timetable and revision planning. These tools store entries only in this browser on this device.
For GPA, review the sample grading scale first. It is editable and is not verified University grading policy.
Here is an illustrative calculation, not a student's record. Three units at five points and two units at four points give an estimated GPA of four point six zero.
Use Timetable for your own schedule, and the study planner to prioritise topics. Export a backup before clearing browser storage.

chapters.title: Announcements and Events
paragraphs: Announcements contains dated chapter notices. Open a headline to read the full information and related links.
Check the publication date and event details. The orientation notice explains which arrangements are still awaiting confirmation.
Events is a separate directory. Check the dates: an archived activity is a reference, rather than a current invitation.

chapters.title: Community and Executives
paragraphs: Community explains study circles, peer learning and support routes. Published links may take you to an external service.
Open Executives to read chapter leadership profiles and find the appropriate office.
This is public community information, not the future Pharmaideia group chat.

chapters.title: Gallery
paragraphs: Gallery groups published departmental photographs into albums. Open a photograph for the corrected full-screen viewer.
Use Next and Previous, or the arrow keys, to browse. Zoom is available when you need a closer look.
Close the viewer with the Close button or Escape to return to the gallery.
Download copy prepares an image with the NIPSA watermark. The original image remains unchanged.

chapters.title: Student Ads
paragraphs: Student Ads lists businesses and services with the details supplied for each entry.
Read a listing and choose its available contact action, such as a phone or external messaging link.
Entries labelled as samples are illustrative. For advertising enquiries, use the published contact route. This walkthrough does not place an order or make a payment.

chapters.title: Campus Navigator preview
paragraphs: Campus Navigator is an Interactive Preview. Try directory search, filters and record details.
Candidate records still await verification. The Map view explains why there are no verified destinations to display.
Building coordinates, full campus coverage and route directions are not available. Confirm practical directions through official university or departmental channels.

chapters.title: Getting help
paragraphs: Use Contact to find the published office or support address that fits your enquiry.
For a broken link or outdated page, email the listed information address with the page URL and a short explanation.
Return to Menu, Resources or the Student Portal whenever you need another starting point. Explore at your own pace.
